lead.description: the practice of assigning treatments, holding other conditions fixed, and keeping an untreated comparison

overview_sentence: [Scientific control](articles/scientific-control.qmd) holds conditions fixed and keeps a comparison that did not receive the experimental treatment.

self_checks.title: Two means
self_checks.prompt: Drug changes sum to 54 over 6 patients and placebo changes sum to 18 over 6. What is the contrast of means?
self_checks.answer: The means are 9 and 3, so the contrast is 6.

self_checks.title: Extra placebo
self_checks.prompt: The placebo changes sum to 22 over 7 patients and the drug mean stays 9. What is the placebo mean?
